<function name="PlayerSetModel" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>
Called whenever a player spawns and must choose a model. A good place to assign a model to a player.
<note>This function may not work in your custom gamemode if you have overridden your <page>GM:PlayerSpawn</page> and you do not use <page text="self.BaseClass.PlayerSpawn">Global.DEFINE_BASECLASS</page> in it, or <page>hook.Call</page> this hook from <page>GM:PlayerSpawn</page>.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player being chosen</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Sets the player's model to Odessa</description>
	<code>
function GM:PlayerSetModel( ply )
   ply:SetModel( "models/player/odessa.mdl" )
end
	</code>

</example>
